quarterly_data.quarter: Perplexity press release: Perplexity Computer runs fully local on Mac (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Perplexity launched Computer fully local on Mac: the AI model, harness and task execution run entirely on Macs with Apple silicon, using Qwen 3.6 or PPLX Pro (a post-trained version of Qwen), working across local files and Mac apps without sending personal data to the cloud; it follows Personal Computer for Mac (May) and Hybrid Compute (last month).
